messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Thanks for coming back, Greg, and sorry you didn't get a proper answer on this the other day.

Order Shop···· is paid and nothing has shipped yet. Your Magic Miner 40T ships October 31, 2026, with the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA going out in the same box.

You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to (email hidden) automatically the day it leaves. Anything else I can check for you?
I’m possibly moving locations by then can I still cancel or change shipping location

Yes on the address, easily. Nothing has shipped, so just give me the new address when you know it and I'll update it on the order and with our warehouse before it goes out. Same country is simple; a different country I'd check first.

On cancelling, your 40T is being built for you and ships October 31, so the move doesn't have to cost you the order. Cancelling isn't standard practice here, and if you still wanted it, the request would have to go to a supervisor for review.
Ok, just to clarify when I placed the order the disclaimer said orders can be cancelled anytime prior to shipping

Understood, and I'm not disputing what you read. I just can't action a cancellation myself; that goes to a supervisor to review, and I won't promise an outcome or an amount on their behalf.

Honestly though, you may not need it. If the move is within the US, I can change the ship-to address right up until it leaves the warehouse, so the order follows you.

Want me to put the cancellation request in anyway, or hold off until your move is settled?
Let me check I’ll get back to you thanks

Sounds good, Greg. Nothing changes on your side in the meantime, and the address can be updated right up until it ships.

Before you go, one thing: what made cancelling come to mind rather than just sending it to the new address?
My plans have changed and I will be moving around a lot the next 12 months and this is just another thing to keep moving with me.

That makes sense. The 40T is a small desktop unit, not a rack, so it travels better than most, but it still needs somewhere to plug in and a bit of patience with noise.

One more: when you do settle somewhere, is mining still the plan, or has that cooled off too?
I would still like to mine

Good, then the order's worth keeping. Tell me the address whenever you land somewhere, even close to the ship date, and I'll move it over.

Last one, and thanks for humouring me: is there somewhere it could sit in the meantime, a family place or storage, or does it have to be wherever you are?
